# Overviews

An overview fills a whole page. Use it as a [screensaver](../screensavers.md) over a HouseView carousel, as a page card in the `cards` list, or as a standalone card with the card type in the third column.

| Overview | Type | Card type | Entity | Since |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| [Weather overview](weather.md) | `weather` | `custom:houseview-weather-overview-card` | required, a `weather` entity | 1.0 |
| [Timer display](timer.md) | `timer` | `custom:houseview-timer-overview-card` | required, a `timer` entity | 1.0 |
| [Cover art](cover_art.md) | `cover_art` | `custom:houseview-cover-art-overview-card` | required, a `media_player` entity | 1.0 |
| [Photo frame](photo_frame.md) | `photo_frame` | `custom:houseview-photo-frame-overview-card` | none | 1.0 |
| [Month calendar](calendar_month.md) | `calendar_month` | `custom:houseview-calendar-month-overview-card` | none | 1.0 |
